newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds dip slightly, slow after gains.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds dip slightly, slow after gains.

text.p: Argentine bonds were flat to lower late morning Friday as the market took a breather from recent gains with investors were said to be waiting for prices to dip before they commit new funds.
"The tendency continues to be higher," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was flat at 95-1/8 while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 was down $0.07 to 118.55.
"There are genuine funds coming into the market," said another trader.
However, he added that investors who are neutral or those that want to build up their positions are waiting for the market to dip before getting in.
"There are some people waiting," he said.
